rule: exactly these 12 keys, in this order; changes require a coordinated minor in all three repos

keys.name: prompt_tokens
keys.doc: All input tokens, including cached reads/writes

keys.name: cache_read_tokens
keys.doc: Subset of prompt_tokens served from provider cache

keys.name: cache_write_tokens
keys.doc: Subset of prompt_tokens written to provider cache

keys.name: estimated
keys.doc: true unless every call was priced by gateway or litellm

keys.name: served_model
keys.doc: Model that served the last call

keys.name: gateway
keys.doc: GW gateway name; null = direct provider
